title: Going All the Way
description: An outgoing Korean War veteran (Ben Affleck) befriends an introspective comrade (Jeremy Davies) in their Indianapolis hometown.

title: Don't Tell Mom the Babysitter's Dead
description: 17-year-old Tanya and her three siblings are left in the charge of a crotchety old babysitter who suddenly dies. Posing as an adult, Tanya gets an assistant gig at a fashion company and is thrust into the world of adulthood and parenting.

title: House
description: A mounted fish moves, household objects levitate, and monsters haunt a troubled novelist (William Katt).

title: Until Death
description: After waking from a coma, a troubled detective (Jean-Claude Van Damme) must save his kidnapped wife from the men he tried to apprehend.

title: Once Upon a Time in China II
description: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

title: The Dead Girl
description: In a quintet of stories, the murder of a young runaway connects a group of unrelated women (Toni Collette, Rose Byrne, Mary Beth Hurt).

title: Abduction
description: A man steps out of a fountain in a park in Ho Chi Minh City with no memory of who he is. He wanders the city trying to piece together his past while being pursued by mysterious figures.

title: City on Fire
description: An undercover cop (Chow Yun-Fat) infiltrates a gang of jewel thieves, but things go terribly wrong during a heist.

title: Dragon Fist
description: A kung-fu student avenges the slaying of his master, with help from his master's clan.

title: An Eye for an Eye
description: A San Francisco policeman (Chuck Norris) quits the force to avenge his partner's murder by Asian drug dealers.

title: Quadrophenia
description: A rebellious teen vents his anger with the Mods and the Rockers in 1964 London. Based on the album by the Who.

title: Deadly Outlaw: Rekka
description: A yakuza (Riki Takeuchi) becomes the target of two clans after the murder of his beloved boss.

title: Bullet in the Head
description: Three Hong Kong gang fighters (Tony Leung Chiu Wai, Jacky Cheung, Waise Lee) try crime in Vietnam and land in a prison camp with U.S. soldiers.

title: Children of the Corn
description: A doctor (Peter Horton) and his girlfriend (Linda Hamilton) see no adults in a Nebraska town run by a crop of teens.

title: Side Effects
description: A woman's (Rooney Mara) world unravels after her psychiatrist (Jude Law) prescribes a new medication to treat her anxiety.

title: Basmati Blues
description: When a young scientist learns she has unwittingly aided a destructive plan against the Indian farmers she was supposedly sent to help, she teams up with a local farmer to save the day.

title: Standing Up, Falling Down
description: A failing stand-up comedian and an alcoholic dermatologist give each other the confidence to face the failures in their lives.

title: The Rebound
description: A newly single woman (Catherine Zeta-Jones) becomes involved with the much-younger man (Justin Bartha) she hired to take care of her children.

title: The Tai Chi Master
description: Two Shaolin Temple pupils (Jet Li, Chin Siu-hou) take different life paths, leading to an ultimate battle between them.

title: A Walk to Remember
description: Forced to tutor students at a school, a young delinquent (Shane West) falls for a minister's (Peter Coyote) daughter (Mandy Moore).

title: Security
description: A mall security guard has to protect a female witness from a gang after they lose all forms of communication during a storm.

title: Animal Factory
description: Sentenced to the state penitentiary for dealing drugs, a middle-class young man (Edward Furlong) seeks protection from a savvy inmate (Willem Dafoe).

title: Last Straw
description: Masked assailants converge on a roadside diner where a young waitress is working the night shift alone. Trapped inside with no place to go, she soon finds herself in a brutal fight for survival as she tries to make it out alive.

title: Dead Reckoning
description: A young woman must foil the terrorist who killed her parents before he strikes again on the island of Nantucket.

title: The Exorcist III: Legion
description: A police detective (George C. Scott) investigates a series of slayings done in the style of an executed killer (Brad Dourif).

title: A Better Tomorrow III
description: Cheung meets a beautiful gang-leader while trying to bring his family from wartime Saigon to Hong Kong.

title: Stay Cool
description: A successful author (Mark Polish) reunites with a high-school beauty (Winona Ryder) when he returns to his hometown.

title: Fever Pitch
description: A teacher (Colin Firth), obsessed with soccer and a team that hasn't won a league cup in 18 years, begins a shaky relationship.

title: Raise the Titanic
description: A U.S. admiral (Jason Robards) and his team (Richard Jordan, David Selby) compete with Russians in an attempt to salvage the luxury liner.

title: Night of the Living Dead
description: A ragtag group of Pennsylvanians barricade themselves in an old farmhouse to remain safe from a horde of flesh-eating ghouls that are ravaging the United States.

title: Bloodfist
description: A Los Angeles kickboxer (Don "The Dragon" Wilson) trains with a master (Joe Marie Avellana) in Manila to avenge his brother in a tournament.

title: Battle Creek Brawl
description: In the 1930s, an effete Chicago mobster (Jose Ferrer) pits a Chinese kicker (Jackie Chan) against a king-size brute called Kiss.

title: Point Break
description: An FBI agent (Keanu Reeves) turns California surfer to nab bank robbers who wear rubber masks of four ex-presidents.

title: Infernal Affairs
description: A troubled officer (Tony Leung) under deep cover and a corrupt cop (Andy Lau) each try to divine the other's identity within a crime lord's organization.

title: Infernal Affairs II
description: In this prequel to the original, a rebel policeman sets up the infiltration of Triad gangs and tries to bring down a corrupt cop working for the Triad boss.

title: Infernal Affairs III
description: Ten months after the murder of Yan, Ming is set to work on mundane office duties; Yeung reminds Ming of his own suspicious rise to fame.

title: Hard-Boiled
description: A police officer and an undercover colleague embark on a blood-splattered quest to crush a gun smuggling ring.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Once Upon a Time in China II
description: A martial arts teacher (Jet Li) protects his students and his aunt (Rosamund Kwan) from a mercenary.

title: Once Upon a Time in China III
description: A martial-arts master (Jet Li) defends his father from several gangs during a competition in Beijing.

title: Once Upon a Time in China
description: A man (Jet Li) must protect his martial-arts school while sorting out his feelings for a young woman (Biao Yuen) who is his aunt by adoption.

title: Legacy of Rage
description: Sentenced to prison for a crime he did not commit, a man sets out for revenge after his release from jail.
